purpose: Record the post-down-correctness route selection before any further generalized token-rate source edits.

down_gpu_correctness.decision: Down GPU Q8_0 CPU-order correctness is fixed and reproducible; this is a correctness gate only, not token-rate SOTA.

limited_upgate_default.decision: Limited DS4 up/gate defaults to exact explicit math unless the bad fused op is deliberately reopened.

limited_upgate_allow_fused.decision: GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1 remains forbidden for token-rate benchmarking until act parity is exact.

current_exact_graph_dataflow.reason: The accepted graph still does not expose a retained gate output to build_expert_mix; DS4_HOT recomputes gate and adds payload.

next_implementation_rule.required_before_source_edit: A new hard-bound artifact showing prompt-general calibration/dev min_eval_tok_s >= 5.5 before coding.
candidate_routes: Exact retained-gate/up/down dataflow interface that removes or hides both gate source movement and most up/down CPU fallback without changing logits.
Correctness-verified compact representation/model route that fits 32GB VRAM and strict 16GB host RAM/page cache.
Fixed real fused up/gate op: GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1 must first pass act parity with max_abs_sum_diff=0.0, then a separate generalized hard-bound must clear >5 tok/s after overhead.
next_implementation_rule.held_out_policy: Held-out prompts remain reserved until a candidate configuration is frozen.
next_implementation_rule.accepted_improvement_policy: Any accepted generalized improvement must record exact reproduction details and immediately push source plus records to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb.

immediate_next_action.preferred: Build a retained-gate interface feasibility hard-bound, because full up/down removal alone is not enough for worst generalized prompts unless gate source movement is also removed or hidden.
immediate_next_action.fallback: Build compact representation feasibility proof if retained-gate cannot clear the target.
